objective: Admit bounded agentic inference cache hints for a session-bound route and qualification surface without pinning memory, executing inference, scheduling hardware, or granting model/provider authority.

research_inputs.finding: The workload-router-pool architecture separates workload characterization, routing, and inference-pool placement, with agent/session/tool/caller signals and KV-cache topology affecting placement.
research_inputs.implementation_impact: FAISAL validates session, route, surface, priority, output-length, prefill, and cache-TTL hints as a separate admission contract.

research_inputs.finding: Agentic inference exhibits repeated KV-cache reuse; structured hints such as priority, estimated output sequence length, speculative prefill, and cache-control TTL can inform an orchestrator.
research_inputs.implementation_impact: FAISAL emits a deterministic cache-placement recommendation while explicitly refusing to pin memory, execute inference, or treat provider metadata as authority.

features: session-bound route and qualification-surface cache key
bounded priority and estimated output-length hints
session-chain replay and cross-surface reuse rejection
generation, freshness, nonce, tamper, and authority fences
recommendation-only output with memory_pinned=false and execution_performed=false

benchmark.scope: local Python control-plane admission overhead; excludes actual KV-cache allocation, model inference, GPU scheduling, network, storage, and production approval latency

limitations: The contract validates caller-supplied hints and does not observe actual cache residency, hit rate, eviction, GPU memory, or runtime behavior.
The recommendation does not pin memory or reserve accelerator capacity.
The benchmark does not demonstrate improved TTFT, throughput, tokens/sec, utilization, or energy efficiency.
The work is a user-space/control-plane contract and does not establish AGI capability, production approval, physical hardware qualification, or Linux superiority.

rollback.rollback_scope: remove the KV-cache admission module, tests, benchmark, runner, evidence registration, and metadata; retain the runtime-assurance release tag
